chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Arrangers' rehearsal schedule at the Boston engagement
summary: Arrangers like Van, Mundy and Dixon came on set days; special rehearsals were held for Ella apart from big-band rehearsals.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: So while we were playing Boston -- Levaggi's LaVodges -- when we first went to LaVodges --
When we first went to Boston, that's when Chick was living -- when we was playing LaVodges, little eatery places up there and Artie was up there --
And that night when Ella -- I was busy doing something with Chick and Ella and Artie. Tony was over (Inaudible) -- Chick wanted to see me. I told Van, "Put this down for Ella."
No. This is at the place where we were playing. Van The band was up for rehearsal.
See, the arrangers had to come up on a

Tuesday and -- Van would come up like on a Tuesday and maybe Jimmy Mundy or Charlie Dixon would come up on a Thursday. We never had the whole staff of arrangers at one time.
We'd have a special rehearsal maybe for Ella and somebody else in the band who's going to do something, or some arrangements we want to clean up.
It wouldn't be no band rehearsal. It would be what we was going to do for Ella -- that particular rehearsal.
Then the other rehearsal, the big band rehearsal, she wouldn't have to come at all because we won't be doing anything with her.
We would just be working on the band, cleaning up some parts of the instruments, the section that wasn't being played clean. We always working on something.

Yeah. Very good writer. Charlie Shavers, yeah. We made that a hit for him.
